name: Transcode Downloader (Testing)
description: TEST BUILDS ONLY — Adds a quality-selection download button to Jellyfin item detail pages.
overview: Test/pre-release builds. Not for production use. Adds a 'Download (Transcode…)' entry to the More menu on every movie and episode detail page.

versions.changelog:
Test build for the upcoming v1.0.27.

- Delete the server-side transcode temp file after a download finishes,
  is cancelled, or fails (#34).
- Hand downloads to the system browser in the Jellyfin Android app, whose
  WebView silently discards blob downloads (#35).

feat: choose video and audio codec for transcoded downloads

- The quality sheet now offers a video and an audio codec picker, limited to
  what the server actually has enabled
- Downloads started from an episode list target the episode whose menu you
  opened, instead of the season or series the page is showing
- Failed or empty transcodes now report the real HTTP status instead of
  silently producing a broken file
fix: transcoding was defaulting to a very low transcode instead of the choosen one
fix: reload strings when Jellyfin language changes mid-session
fix: reload strings when Jellyfin language changes mid-session

fix: read locale from document.documentElement.lang

Jellyfin does not expose globalize on window — it is a pure ES module.
globalize writes the current normalized locale to document.documentElement.lang
during init, which is the reliable global hook. Fixes translations always
falling back to English.

fix: i18n strings now load in the correct Jellyfin UI language

Translations were broken due to two bugs in the globalize integration:
- translate() key format was inverted (module#key vs key#module)
- loadStrings() expected webpack import paths, not pre-fetched JSON
Locale is now read from globalize.getCurrentLocale() and strings are
stored locally, bypassing Jellyfin's registry entirely.
Fix language setting not respected — always showed German strings
